App concept
  1. Sunday afternoon

    Imagine Your brand in her pocket.

    Her best friend's birthday is on Tuesday. She needs a gift, and she's scrolling PinkOut.

    Stays on this device. It just makes the story yours.

    Scroll to follow her

  2. Browse

    She opens the shop.

    Beauty, fashion, accessories, sweets, gifts and lifestyle, picked for her world.

  3. Featured

    Your brand, in the Gift Edit.

    Featured moments, like gift edits and themed-day picks, put your products in front of her.

  4. Your story

    She meets Your brand.

    Your brand page tells her who made it and why. That's what makes her choose you.

  5. In her bag

    Added to bag.

    Your product, her gift, ordered in a minute.

  6. After

    And she comes back.

    The gift lands, her friend asks where it came from, and Your brand is one tap away for both of them.

FAQ

Good questions, clear answers.

What exactly is PinkOut?

A women-first lifestyle, creativity and entertainment destination coming soon to Riyadh, with seven experience zones and an app in development.

When and where does it open?

In Riyadh. The exact date and venue will be announced once confirmed.

What are the fees or commission?

Commercial terms are shared after you apply, in the deck for your partner type.

Are any partners confirmed?

No partnerships have been announced yet.

When can I sell in the app?

When the PinkOut app launches. Shop partners sell through the app.

Can I sell at the event?

Not as an Shop partner: selling happens in the PinkOut app. If your brand wants a presence at the event, enquire as an event partner.

What can I sell?

Products that fit PinkOut's categories: beauty, fashion, accessories, sweets and treats, gifts and lifestyle.
